explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 88 to 56 lines (36.4%) and from 6,044 to 3,821 characters (36.8%). Five peripherals expand camera/input behavior, projection, settlement, renderer-local state, and routing. The central tree retains modular boundaries and ownership; peripherals mix call sequences, resource lifetimes, and data dependencies. Connections attach to the corresponding concept lines. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps and no overlapping diagrams.

Source-grounded clarifications: CanvasRuntime clears node focus on revision or selection changes, while edge removal clears edge focus. MappingEditorCanvas's paste handler stops propagation; the supplied implementation does not itself invoke the application paste command. MappingEditorRuntime rejects the entire temporary clone batch if any clone is unsupported. Collapsed or docked conversations project as bubbles, but settlement updates canvasAnchor only for collapsed conversations. NativeRoutingStore schedules reactive invalidation after worker failure; a later draw routes synchronously. Its disposal clears worker jobs and results while retaining obstacle owners, measurements, and router caches.

Details absent from the seed include projection exclusions, root-parent handling, camera initialization precedence, controller-forced settlement without selection capture, model-atom retention, and preserved arrow object identity. Evidence is limited to the point definition, seven embedded source files, and seed. Imported helper, controller, SDK, and worker implementations were not supplied, so their internal behavior is not inferred. Camera capture calls the controller but remains separate from semantic gesture commits.
